per_dataset_confirmation_rule.partial_confirmation: safety reduction, mean risk, dataset independence and frozen split checks pass but at least one remaining check fails
per_dataset_confirmation_rule.not_confirmed: the mean safety signal or protocol-independence checks fail

series_rule.partial_confirmation: every confirmation dataset achieves FULL_CONFIRMATION or PARTIAL_CONFIRMATION, but at least one is not full
series_rule.not_confirmed: at least one confirmation dataset is NOT_CONFIRMED

gate_policy: No public cross-dataset result alone changes Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW or authorizes production use.
